facts.claim: Disney Wish (Disney Cruise Line): Entered service 2022; 144,000 GT; 2500 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 348 m length; Wish class.
Disney Wish is a cruise ship owned and operated by Disney Cruise Line, a subsidiary of the Walt Disney Company.
She is the fifth ship in the Disney Cruise Line fleet and the lead vessel of the Wish class.
The ship was followed by sister ships Disney Treasure (2024) and Disney Destiny (2025), with two additional ships in the class scheduled to enter service in 2027 and 2029.

catalogSpecs.description: The first Triton Class ship, featuring the AquaMouse and Frozen dining.
